title: X02 E2E protocol: production twin-dispatch chain (walls -> SVF -> run), bitwise A/B vs the Phase-0 baseline corpus
frozen_before_timing: 2026-10-16, commit that follows 9133c693 (the X02 dispatch commit); no timing run has happened under this protocol

change_under_test.summary: shadows.shadow routes on the static bush predicate: bush>0 -> step-major serial (unchanged regime), bush==0 -> sky_compiled.shadow_pixel_parallel (pixel-parallel twin, bitwise-verified in Phase 0)

driver: /storage/scratch1/1/dsynn6/solweig-light-s11-raw/phase1/x02_e2e.py (hard-asserts protocol commit ancestry, product-diff file list + sha, scene manifest sha before any timed work)

scene.per_arm: fresh cold copy to node-local /tmp/s11_x02_<tag>; .solweig-light and SVF wiped before the pass (cold C6-40 phase route, p1c pattern)

b1_38.purpose: dispatch effect isolated at the default shape

b2_54.purpose: candidate policy shape; admission pre-check (5 concurrent jobs fit at default budget per Phase-0 p0_env)

timing_rules.passes: exactly one timed chain pass per arm; untimed 64^2 prime first (shared NUMBA_CACHE_DIR=$RAW/numba_cache, twin kernels already compiled in Phase 0)
timing_rules.retries: zero; a single causal retry is permitted only on a documented infrastructure anomaly (crash, node eviction, admission refusal), never on an undesired number
timing_rules.segments: perf_counter around run_walls_aspect, _calculate_svf (with p1b-pattern execute_geometry_phase + prepare_geometry_exports seams), run_utci_tiles; seams proven non-perturbing (p1b reproduced the A-arm svf phase within 0.7%)
timing_rules.run_flags: full save-flag set (tmrt,svf,kup,kdown,lup,ldown,shadow,wbgt,ta,wind), matching the S10-36 A-arm run-segment conditions (portfolio harness)

baseline_anchors.chain: S10-36 A-arm: walls 20.044 + svf 4063.135 + run 2529.695 = 6612.874 s (development/optimization_s10_semantic_systems/evidence/target/synthetic_scale_demo.json)
baseline_anchors.svf_phase_reproduction_band: p1b 4090.5 / p1c base38 4069.9 reproduce the A-arm svf phase 4063.1 within 0.7%
baseline_anchors.twin_phase_anchor: p1c w5t4twin: barrier 355.0 + export 2746.9 = 3101.9 s phase, bitwise PASS 24/24
baseline_anchors.tmrt_anchor: /storage/scratch1/1/dsynn6/solweig-light-s11-raw/phase0/p2_ref_TMRT.tif (tile 0_0, 24 bands, clean reference run at 8 threads, workers=1)

bitwise_criteria.svf: all 24 tiles x all persisted SVF artifacts equal vs p1c_svf_base38 (probe_lib.compare_svf_artifacts, uint4-view NaN-mask equality); any diff = candidate rejected
bitwise_criteria.tmrt: TMRT_0_0.tif all bands equal vs p2_ref_TMRT.tif (same equality)

acceptance.accept_x02: bitwise criteria PASS and b1_38 svf-phase wall <= 3920 s (>= 3.5% below the p1c base38 4069.9 reproduction band; guards against a no-op dispatch)
acceptance.shape_recommendation: recorded from b2_54 vs b1_38 chain walls; not a gate (run-phase shape sensitivity is a measured outcome, X02's gate is bitwise + svf-phase at default shape)
acceptance.sanity_watch: b1_38 run-phase wall far outside the 2529.7 s A-arm band (>+/-10%) flags machine drift -> causal-retry review; b2_54 run wall may legitimately differ (4 vs 8 engine threads) and is recorded, not gated

environment.numba: NUMBA_CACHE_DIR shared with Phase 0; threading_layer omp; worker env caps via production _child_environment
environment.origin: repo .venv editable install of branch src; job echoes git rev-parse HEAD + product diff file list

review_gate: independent review agent must inspect the accepted diff (mandated for every numerical/scheduling change) before the candidate is marked accepted in REGISTER.md
